title: Concept: Dependency declared with an x-range major
description: package.json declares an `N.x` major range, which accepts every minor and patch release of that major, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Any release in the major line satisfies the declaration, so a breaking or compromised minor reaches the build without a manifest change.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: Any release in the major line satisfies the declaration, so a breaking or compromised minor reaches the build without a manifest change.
